'''Var-Nok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of the [[Cult of the Screaming Blade]] leader [[Paladius]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he and [[Shar-Nok]] engaged [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] alongside their master, but were defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Var-Nok appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
